title: Professor Emeritus, National Security Affairs, Naval War College & Senior Fellow, Women in International Security
bio: "Many of my students have gone on to publish articles relating the class material to their own fields, creating artwork to share the Women, Peace & Security message, and becoming activists in their local communities." Field: International Relations
